remarks: Located in East Norwalk within Fairfield County, this commercially zoned two-car garage offers a flexible and functional space suitable for a variety of business uses.  The property is ideal for vehicle parking and storage, contractor equipment storage, or automotive-related projects. The space features two overhead garage doors for easy access, along with a standard fire-rated entry door.  Property Highlights:  Commercial zoning Two-car garage layout Two overhead doors Fire-rated entry door Suitable for automotive or contractor use Available for immediate occupancy  This is a great opportunity for small business owners, contractors, or automotive professionals seeking a well-located and accessible space.
